recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Body: Kyle and Serena Denton are community herbalists creating wild-crafted and organic plant medicines out of Milwaukee since 2015. I have used their teas and tinctures on an almost daily basis for years now. Kyle is a great friend of InnerVerse and has appeared on the channel more times than I can count. These products work—not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

In other words, LotusWei Elixirs help me be a better podcaster and Biofield Tuner. Benefits accumulate over long term use!

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Marty Leeds and the Mathematics of 13", "body": "Chance works through the unlucky number 13 chapter of Marty Leeds's Pi in the English Alphabet, starting with the septenary cipher, where the 26 letter alphabet splits into two sets of 13 and words like lord, pope, god and zero each sum to 13. He wonders whether half of the 26 of YHVH makes 13 a half of God, notes that the word thirteen totals 41 in that cipher and, with 13 mirrored as 31, spells out 3141, and demonstrates on a calculator that squares of 11, 12 and 13 mirror their reversals, a pattern that breaks at 14 and 41."}, {"title": "Metatron's Cube, Fibonacci and the Golden Ratio", "body": "Reading from Leeds, Chance describes Metatron's cube as 13 equal circles, twelve around one, that he says encode the basic shapes of geometry, which he calls the best version of math because it measures what exists in nature. He walks through the Fibonacci sequence and its ratios creeping toward phi, 1.618, and offers his view that nature is always approximating a perfection it never reaches. He adds that decimal parity reduction of Fibonacci gives cycles of 24 summing to 108, then what he believes is 117, while asking viewers to check his figures."}, {"title": "Ophiuchus and a Thirteen Month Year", "body": "The serpent bearer Ophiuchus runs through the whole stream. Chance asks whether a person standing at the center of the twelve rotating signs is the 13th point, raises the Law of Time's Mayan calendar of 13 sets of 20, and reads Leeds's 364 day calendar of 13 months of 28 days, echoed in 13 cards per suit. He argues that how we divide time shapes how we think. Gabriel notes that Ophiuchus begins on November 22, the day John F. Kennedy, C.S. Lewis and Aldous Huxley died, and Chance hunts for images of the figure stepping out of the zodiac."}, {"title": "Pierre Sabak on Shining Wheels and Serpents", "body": "Chance reads from Pierre Sabak's glossary in Holographic Culture and the Murder of Reality, where the ophanim wheels of biblical and apocryphal texts are described as illuminated vehicles, and Sabak links the Aramaic ofan, wheel, to words for viper and gray across Hebrew and Arabic. Chance wonders aloud whether some lights in the sky could be merkaba light bodies, ties shields and coats of arms to naval symbolism, and reads grey aliens as replicated beings. He closes by saying he suspects serpent symbolism is neutral, and wants to find its positive linguistic links."}, {"title": "Hidden Thirteens in Words and Myth", "body": "With Gabriel of Slick Dissident, the talk turns to what the pair see as 13 concealed in language and ritual. Gabriel argues Ophiuchus represents Baphomet, crediting Tracy Twyman, and compares the constellation to the Susquehanna River. He reads Jackie Kennedy's turn back to her husband as a reenactment of the Orpheus myth and notes that lab coat is lamb coat missing the M, the 13th letter. Chance ties M to mother and matter. In the finale Gabriel offers his speculative theory that the Mississippi is the true Nile of the Osiris story."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: I randomly hit the live stream airwaves to talk about 13. After awhile, Slick Dissident (Gabriel) joined to help me elaborate.
